message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the downloaded or loaded data; the code only checks whether a directory or file exists before proceeding.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code downloads a file from Google Drive using a hard-coded file ID but performs no checksum verification, signature validation, or any other integrity check on the downloaded content.
No detected label flipping detection: Labels are extracted directly from filenames via string splitting with no validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or noise-detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset processing loads audio files and computes features without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The `load_gru` function in models.py calls `torch.load(file_path)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded model weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD perturbations are used anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and while a test split appears to be created in load_dataset, the code is truncated and shows no explicit isolation guarantees, multiple independent metrics, or other tamper-protection mechanisms.
No detected input sanitization: The pipeline loads .wav files and passes extracted features directly to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation anywhere in the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (log-softmax probabilities) are returned and printed without any NaN guards, confidence threshold checks, or probability sanity bounds.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio-based speech emotion recognition model (LSTM/GRU/RNN), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
